claim: DOM/accessibility tree not available for Flutter desktop application without runtime inspection.

evidence.note: Structural Coherence requires DOM or accessibility tree dump with computed properties. Flutter uses its own rendering pipeline; accessibility tree requires runtime inspection via Accessibility Insights or similar tooling.

evidence.note: Focus traversal in Flutter depends on widget tree order and FocusNode configuration. Runtime testing required to verify actual focus sequence.

evidence.note: Flutter Semantics widget usage in source code does not guarantee runtime accessibility; actual semantic tree inspection required.

evidence.note: Flutter does not use HTML heading elements; semantic heading roles require runtime accessibility tree inspection.
